t: The Good Thinking Society is a nonprofit organisation that promotes scientific scepticism. It was set up in September 2012 by Simon Singh, who is the reason it exists. Singh is a British science writer, and his books include Fermat's Last Theorem, The Code Book, Big Bang, and Trick or Treatment, about alternative medicine on trial. In the year he founded the society, he also created a website called Parallel, which helps students learn mathematics. So this is an organisation shaped by a science communicator's habit of testing claims and explaining ideas.
